# BAD-064 — collab: join answers one reason with two status codes

## Brief
A join code that does not normalize (normalizeJoinCode returns null) answers 404 {allowed:false, reason:'unknown_code'}; a code that normalizes fine but names no room falls through to decideJoin and answers 403 with the SAME body. Same word, two statuses, decided by a detail the person typing has no way to see. Clients branch on data.code || data.error and on the join shape's reason, so nothing is broken today, but any client or proxy that keys on status treats one typo as 'not found' and the next as 'forbidden'. Worth settling deliberately rather than inheriting it through the BAD-047 split, where one of the two is easy to normalize away by accident.

Evidence: collab/index.ts:430 (the 404) and :469's decideJoin path (the 403); _shared/collab.mjs decideJoin returns reason 'unknown_code' for a null collab. Both pinned in test/server/functions.test.mjs, 'collab: join names an unknown code two ways, and a rejoin is the same seat': 'not a code' -> 404, 'BT-ZZZZZZ' -> 403, identical bodies.
